feature: Local git branch and worktree cleanup
gating: Run layers in order. Do not run a layer until every case in the layer before it passes.

unit.case: survey parsing: one JSON document built from for-each-ref inventory, worktree list --porcelain and rev-list ahead/behind counts, buckets present
PROTECTED regex filter: main/master/develop and release/* never appear in any delete bucket
non-standard default branch: origin/HEAD normalizes to the local default (e.g. trunk) and that branch is never deletable
current branch is always keep and never listed as deletable
two-segment clustering: branch names like feat/login group with their cluster and are still individually classified
triage: merged branch → SAFE_TO_DELETE carrying verifyWith git merge-base --is-ancestor 'refs/heads/<branch>' '<default>' (default branch, not an upstream)
triage: branch with unpushed commits → UNPUSHED_WORK keep
triage: [gone] remote branch → ambiguous/needs-investigation, never deletable
triage: branch tracked and level with a live remote → SYNCED keep
refname single-quoting: every emitted refname and path is quoted, including names containing $(...), backticks and single quotes
worktree dirty flagging: a dirty worktree is flagged refused, never queued for removal
unanalyzed surfacing: the unanalyzed bucket is always present, even when every branch classifies
fail-closed on malformed survey input: error or empty delete list, never a delete plan
flow fixture full command plan end to end: every refname/path single-quoted, an ancestry guard before each git branch -d, no protected/current/default branch in any delete
flow fixture: dirty worktree listed as refused and worktree removals ordered before branch deletions
flow fixture: unanalyzed bucket surfaces in the emitted plan
